_comment: The ticketing-events package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.11). They name only its own
types and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything. Every type is organization-owned (X8):
Organizations' row rule narrows each right to the members of the owning organization (Viewer reads, Member creates
and edits, Admin deletes and publishes), so the right alone shows a signed-in user nothing of another seller.
The storefront reads published events through /spark/ticketing/events/public (anonymous). An application that wants
published events in its generic pages too grants { "resource": "QueryRead/TicketEvent", "groupId": "@anonymous" }.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "ticketing-events": false }.
